text:
Maria (CS): drafting a short priming worksheet for customer kickoffs — goal: reduce cold-starts, set batching defaults, and give a clear rollback plan. dropping a compact draft for review.

Ben (Eng): nice. quick notes: start batch_size=8 for convo-style usage, batch_size=4 for latency-first flows. prefill concurrency = 2x normal qps for first 10 minutes to warm K/V.

Sam (SRE): add observability + thresholds. if 5xx > 3% sustained for 2m OR p90 latency > 1200ms, trigger scaledown and traffic-shift. include a Datadog/Splunk query snippet.

Maria (CS): adding a tiny customer-facing script to run during the priming window — low-friction, copy/paste friendly: 

Maria (CS): ```bash
# run 30 sample prefill requests to warm tenant cache
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -d '{"model":"rwd-3b","input":"hello","max_tokens":16}' &
  sleep 0.25
done
wait
```

Jordan (PM): from renewal-risk perspective, capture these handoff metrics: initial latency baseline, cache-hit % in first 24h, error budget burn, and a subjective CS check-in note at 72h. include in the kickoff email.

Ben (Eng): suggested metric queries for the kickoff snapshot: 
`rate(http_requests_total{service="redwood",status!~"5.."}[5m])` for success QPS,
`sum(increase(cache_hits_total[1h])) / sum(increase(cache_lookups_total[1h]))` for cache hit rate,
`histogram_quantile(0.9, sum(rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))` for p90.

Sam (SRE): operational checklist to include in the worksheet:
- Day0 preflight: verify firewall & KMS, confirm model pinning, run 10 warm queries, validate logs pipeline.
- Day1 go-live: enable 1.5x burst capacity if traffic spikes, monitor 5xx and p90, CS daily check-ins for 72h.
- Degradation plan: if 5xx > 5% for 5m, switch traffic to quantized fallback model and open #release-war-room.

Maria (CS): customer email blurb (short):
"Well run a 30-60 minute priming window to warm your tenant cache and calibrate batching. Well share a 24h metrics snapshot and schedule a 72h check-in. If we detect elevated errors well roll to a fallback model and notify you."

Jordan (PM): also include cost transparency: estimate token cost of the prefill (e.g., ~50 requests at rwd-3b) and note Dedicated tenants can request reserved warm pools to avoid burst billing.

Ben (Eng): quick customer-facing start-configs table:
- prefill_requests: 20-100 (prompt-set dependent)
- batch_size: 4 (latency) / 8 (throughput)
- prefill_concurrency: 1-3
- warm_pool: recommended for Dedicated or >5k qps

Maria (CS): final ask: after 72h CS should record one-line feedback: did prefill reduce coldstart errors? yes/no + brief note. I'll add that template to enablement.

cs-bot: reminder set 85
 follow-up checklist to @Maria (CS) scheduled in 72 hours. :white_check_mark:

Maria (CS): thanks all. I'll merge into the enablement repo and attach to kickoff emails. tag me for further tweaks. :pray:
